package main

		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return nil
	})
}

Valid value: <code>BASIC</code>, <code>CLIENT</code>, <code>SERVER</code>, <code>REALSERVER</code> and <code>PROXY</code>. <code>BASIC</code> means basic certificate; <code>CLIENT</code> means client CA certificate; <code>SERVER</code> means server SSL certificate; <code>REALSERVER</code> means realserver CA certificate; <code>PROXY</code> means proxy SSL certificate.</dd></dl>
</pulumi-choosable>
</div>
</pulumi-choosable>
</div>






## Import



GAAP certificate can be imported using the id, e.g.

```sh
  $ pulumi import tencentcloud:Gaap/certificate:Certificate foo cert-d5y6ei3b
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
